+---
+module: nios_fixed_address
+short_description: Manage Infoblox NIOS DHCP fixed addresses
+description:
+  - Creates, updates, and removes IPv4 and IPv6 DHCP fixed addresses through Infoblox WAPI.
+requirements:
+  - infoblox-client
+extends_documentation_fragment: nios
+options:
+  name:
+    description: Name assigned to the fixed address.
+    required: true
+  ipaddr:
+    description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to reserve.
+    required: true
+  mac:
+    description: Hardware MAC address associated with the reservation.
+    required: true
+  network:
+    description: Network containing the fixed address, in CIDR notation.
+    required: true
+  network_view:
+    description: Network view containing the network.
+    default: default
+  options:
+    description: DHCP options to configure on the fixed address.
+    type: list
+    elements: dict
+    suboptions:
+      name:
+        description: DHCP option name. Either name or num is required.
+      num:
+        description: DHCP option number. Either name or num is required.
+        type: int
+      value:
+        description: DHCP option value.
+        required: true
+      use_option:
+        description: Whether to use this DHCP option.
+        type: bool
+        default: true
+      vendor_class:
+        description: DHCP option space.
+        default: DHCP
+  extattrs:
+    description: Extensible attributes as key and value pairs.
+    type: dict
+  comment:
+    description: Comment associated with the fixed address.
+  state:
+    description: Whether the fixed address should exist.
+    choices: [present, absent]
+    default: present
+'''
+
+EXAMPLES = '''
+- name: Reserve an IPv4 address
+  nios_fixed_address:
+    name: printer
+    ipaddr: 192.0.2.10
+    mac: 00:11:22:33:44:55
+    network: 192.0.2.0/24
+    options:
+      - name: domain-name
+        value: example.com
+    provider: "{{ nios_provider }}"
+
+- name: Remove an IPv6 fixed address
+  nios_fixed_address:
+    name: printer6
+    ipaddr: 2001:db8::10
+    mac: 00:11:22:33:44:55
+    network: 2001:db8::/64
+    state: absent
+    provider: "{{ nios_provider }}"
+'''

+from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule
+from ansible.module_utils.six import iteritems
+from ansible.module_utils.net_tools.nios.api import WapiModule
+from ansible.module_utils.net_tools.nios.api import NIOS_IPV4_FIXED_ADDRESS, NIOS_IPV6_FIXED_ADDRESS
+from ansible.module_utils.network.common.utils import validate_ip_address, validate_ip_v6_address
+
+
+def options(module):
+    '''Convert DHCP options to WAPI fields, omitting unset values.'''
+    result = []
+    for item in module.params['options']:
+        option = dict((key, value) for key, value in iteritems(item) if value is not None)
+        if 'name' not in option and 'num' not in option:
+            module.fail_json(msg='one of `name` or `num` is required for option value')
+        if 'value' not in option:
+            module.fail_json(msg='`value` is required for option value')
+        result.append(option)
+    return result
+
+
+def validate_ip_addr_type(ip, arg_spec, module):
+    '''Select the WAPI address field and object type for an IPv4 or IPv6 IP.'''
+    if validate_ip_address(ip):
+        address_field = 'ipv4addr'
+        object_type = NIOS_IPV4_FIXED_ADDRESS
+    elif validate_ip_v6_address(ip):

+        object_type = NIOS_IPV6_FIXED_ADDRESS
+    else:

+

+    module.params[address_field] = module.params.pop('ipaddr')
+    return object_type, arg_spec, module
+
+

+        num=dict(type='int'),
+        value=dict(required=True),

+        vendor_class=dict(default='DHCP')
+    )
+
+    ib_spec = dict(
+        name=dict(required=True),
+        ipaddr=dict(required=True, ib_req=True),
+        mac=dict(required=True, ib_req=True),
+        network=dict(required=True, ib_req=True),
+        network_view=dict(default='default', ib_req=True),
+        options=dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=option_spec, transform=options),
+        extattrs=dict(type='dict'),
+        comment=dict()
+    )
+
+    argument_spec = dict(
+        provider=dict(required=True),
+        state=dict(default='present', choices=['present', 'absent'])
+    )

+    module.exit_json(**result)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+

+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from copy import deepcopy
+
+from ansible.module_utils.net_tools.nios import api
+from ansible.modules.net_tools.nios import nios_fixed_address
+from units.compat.mock import MagicMock, Mock, patch
+from units.modules.utils import set_module_args
+from .test_nios_module import TestNiosModule
+
+
+class TestNiosFixedAddressModule(TestNiosModule):
+    module = nios_fixed_address
+
+    def test_main_selects_address_type_and_identity(self):
+        for ip, object_type, address_field in (
+                ('192.0.2.10', api.NIOS_IPV4_FIXED_ADDRESS, 'ipv4addr'),
+                ('2001:db8::10', api.NIOS_IPV6_FIXED_ADDRESS, 'ipv6addr')):
+            set_module_args(dict(name='printer', ipaddr=ip, mac='00:11:22:33:44:55',
+                                 network='192.0.2.0/24', provider={},
+                                 options=[dict(name='domain-name', value='example.com')]))
+            with patch.object(nios_fixed_address, 'WapiModule') as wapi_class:
+                wapi_class.return_value.run.return_value = {'changed': False}
+                self.changed(False)
+                module = wapi_class.call_args[0][0]
+                called_type, spec = wapi_class.return_value.run.call_args[0]
+                self.assertEqual(called_type, object_type)
+                self.assertIn(address_field, spec)
+                self.assertNotIn('ipaddr', spec)
+                self.assertEqual(module.params[address_field], ip)
+                self.assertTrue(all(spec[key]['ib_req'] for key in (address_field, 'mac', 'network')))
+                self.assertEqual(nios_fixed_address.options(module),
+                                 [dict(name='domain-name', value='example.com',
+                                       use_option=True, vendor_class='DHCP')])
+
+    def test_invalid_ip_is_rejected(self):
+        set_module_args(dict(name='printer', ipaddr='invalid', mac='00:11:22:33:44:55',
+                             network='192.0.2.0/24', provider={}))
+        result = self.failed()
+        self.assertIn('IPv4 or IPv6', result['msg'])
+
+    def test_options_require_identifier(self):
+        module = MagicMock()
+        module.params = {'options': [dict(value='example.com', name=None, num=None)]}
+        module.fail_json.side_effect = ValueError('invalid option')
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+            nios_fixed_address.options(module)
+
+    def test_wapi_lifecycle_and_check_mode(self):
+        params = dict(provider=None, state='present', name='printer',
+                      ipv6addr='2001:db8::10', mac='00:11:22:33:44:55',
+                      network='2001:db8::/64', network_view='default',
+                      options=None, extattrs=None, comment=None)
+        spec = dict(name={}, ipv6addr={'ib_req': True}, mac={'ib_req': True},
+                    network={'ib_req': True}, network_view={'ib_req': True},
+                    options={}, extattrs={}, comment={})
+        module = MagicMock()
+        module.params = params
+        module.check_mode = False
+        with patch.object(api, 'get_connector'):
+            wapi = api.WapiModule(module)
+        wapi.get_object = Mock(return_value=None)
+        wapi.create_object = Mock()
+        wapi.update_object = Mock()
+        wapi.delete_object = Mock()
+        self.assertTrue(wapi.run(api.NIOS_IPV6_FIXED_ADDRESS, spec)['changed'])
+        wapi.get_object.assert_called_with(api.NIOS_IPV6_FIXED_ADDRESS,
+                                           dict(ipv6addr=params['ipv6addr'], mac=params['mac'],
+                                                network=params['network'], network_view='default'),
+                                           return_fields=spec.keys())
+        wapi.create_object.assert_called_once()
+
+        existing = [dict(_ref='ipv6fixedaddress/ref', name='printer',
+                         ipv6addr=params['ipv6addr'], mac=params['mac'],
+                         network=params['network'], network_view='default', comment='old')]
+        wapi.get_object.side_effect = lambda *args, **kwargs: deepcopy(existing)
+        module.params['comment'] = 'old'
+        self.assertFalse(wapi.run(api.NIOS_IPV6_FIXED_ADDRESS, spec)['changed'])
+        module.params['comment'] = 'new'
+        module.check_mode = True
+        self.assertTrue(wapi.run(api.NIOS_IPV6_FIXED_ADDRESS, spec)['changed'])
+        wapi.update_object.assert_not_called()
+        module.check_mode = False
+        self.assertTrue(wapi.run(api.NIOS_IPV6_FIXED_ADDRESS, spec)['changed'])
+        wapi.update_object.assert_called_once()
+        module.params['state'] = 'absent'
+        module.check_mode = True
+        self.assertTrue(wapi.run(api.NIOS_IPV6_FIXED_ADDRESS, spec)['changed'])
+        wapi.delete_object.assert_not_called()
+        module.check_mode = False
+        self.assertTrue(wapi.run(api.NIOS_IPV6_FIXED_ADDRESS, spec)['changed'])
+        wapi.delete_object.assert_called_once_with('ipv6fixedaddress/ref')
